stages/input: A small ConvNet for color images, thirty two by thirty two. Follow the shape from layer to layer.
stages/conv: A three by three conv with sixteen filters and padding one keeps the size and makes sixteen channels: sixteen by thirty two by thirty two.
stages/relu: A ReLU works entry by entry, so the shape does not change.
stages/pool: Max pooling halves the height and the width: sixteen by sixteen by sixteen. That is one stage.
stages/repeat: Repeat it with thirty two filters: thirty two channels, then pooled to eight by eight. The image gets smaller and deeper as it goes.
head/flatten: Flatten lays all of it out in one vector: thirty two times eight times eight, two thousand and forty eight numbers.
head/fc: A fully connected layer then turns those into ten class scores, exactly like a linear classifier.
head/params: Count the parameters. The first convolution has four hundred and forty eight, the second four thousand, six hundred and forty, and the linear layer twenty thousand, four hundred and ninety.
head/most: Pooling and ReLU have none. Most of the parameters sit in that last fully connected layer, even in this tiny network.
